items.title: Responsive overflow, clipped tablet builder and form sizing
before: Home document 463–473px wide at 320–414px viewport; tabs overflow
Builder right panels extend to 1038px at 820–1024px and are clipped
changes: Mobile home tabs contained in their own scroll rail below heading
Builder uses one column through 1050px; existing small-screen rules moved instead of duplicated
Product metadata/prices can wrap; specification values break long tokens
Mobile form controls use at least 16px and text scaling is predictable
checks: 7 browser tests passed: 10 routes at 320,360,390,414,768,820,1024px; right builder panels fit; forms >=16px
Full frontend check passed: 146 tests, formatting, ESLint, TypeScript and production build

items.title: Keep catalog position and overlay geometry during async loading
before: Menu lazy fallback changed header height 56→77→56px
changes: Catalog sort, density and filter updates preserve scroll; refresh indicator occupies a permanent toolbar slot
One fixed dismissible overlay loader for lazy cart/menu replaces in-flow paragraphs
Shared reference-counted body lock supports overlapping overlays and restores original padding/overflow
Native modal uses the same lock; mobile filter sheet fits the current viewport
checks: 149 frontend tests, TypeScript, formatting, lint and production build passed
10 browser tests passed including delayed menu/cart imports, Escape cancellation, unchanged header height, stable scroll and card top during/after delayed catalog refresh
Both overlapping-lock release orders and StrictMode are covered
